page.overview:
Who is Grandea?

Grandea was a Force-sensitive Theelin female who served as a Jedi Knight during the Clone Wars and survived Order 66 and lived well into the New Republic Era. Within a village on Lahtee, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren seemingly came into conflict with Grandea during the First Order-Resistance War. Upon defeating her, however, her body vanished and the whole village around Ren transformed into an abandoned husk of itself, much to Ren's confusion and rage.

Once a Knight of the Jedi Order, Grandea fought in the Clone Wars. During her time in the Order, Grandea was always fascinated by the mind trick, though felt that other Jedi dismissed the technique as undignified. As the war neared its end, Grandea was stationed alongside a unit of the Galactic Republic's clone troopers and the Rodian Jedi Alivar, who studied the Separatists' front lines, discovering a weakness to exploit. As the fatigued Grandea retrieved tea from a dispenser, the clones executed Order 66, a directive to eliminate the Jedi en masse. When confronted, Grandea used a mind trick to make two soldiers believe that she had disguised herself as one of them, turning them against each other.

Grandea received a message from the Jedi temple on Coruscantthat advised the remaining Jedi not to return and to trust in the Force. Without further instruction and possibly the last Jedi, Grandea reached out to the Force, which instructed her to survive. Knowing that the Order's destruction was being met with celebration and the Jedi themselves put to death, Grandea destroyed her lightsaber, buried her Jedi robes, and abandoned the Jedi way. Grandea attempted to hide but was aware of the continued danger, as Sheev Palpatine's new Galactic Empire instituted bounties on any remaining Jedi. Refusing to become a hermit, Grandea continued to improve her mastery of the mind trick. Practicing on a Mon Calamari bartender, a transport pilot, and a merchant, among others, she sought out species with a natural resistance to the ability, including Toydarians and Hutts, learning to overcome the strongest of wills.

Between 18 BBY and 14 BBY, at the command of Darth Vader, Grandea was pursued by two Imperial Inquisitors, the Ninth and Thirteenth Sisters. Grandea fled, losing her right leg to the Thirteenth Sister. As the Ninth Sister stabbed Grandea with her lightsaber, she used a mind trick to convince the Inquisitors that they had indeed killed their prey, the strain of the feat nearly doing so. Grandea crawled away, tearful, and suffered a nosebleed from the intensity of her earlier effort. Her mind trick successful, the Inquisitors reported Grandea's death to Vader, raising only a momentary suspicion.
